audit_scope.task_scope: cell-state mapping only; RNA-conditioned ATAC is ineligible

scmvp_local.corpus: No admitted upstream checkpoint; exact outer-training paired RNA-ATAC cells or nuclei only

hosted_demo_trainers.checkpoint_identity: Baidu/Google Drive pre_trainer.pkl, pre_atac_trainer.pkl, and multi_vae_trainer.pkl referenced by README

interpretation: A locally trained scMVP model has no checkpoint-corpus contamination, but only its RNA encoder is usable for an RNA-only held donor. The released multimodal inference and imputation paths require observed ATAC, infer an ATAC latent, form a joint latent, and compute observed ATAC library size before decoding. These outputs are reconstructions, not RNA-conditioned accessibility. GSE244832 aliquots cannot train the paired model. GSE289173 can in principle seal cell-state mapping through a frozen RNA encoder but cannot seal ATAC profiling.
remaining_blockers: Implement a frozen RNA-only adapter that aligns training genes, forces eval/no-grad, returns the RNA posterior mean, and never constructs or passes an ATAC tensor.
Prove adding, removing, batching, or permuting query cells cannot alter BatchNorm state, GMM parameters, another query embedding, head parameters, prototypes, or calibration.

Freeze GENCODE v49 genes, GRCh38.p14 peaks, assay transforms, architecture, GMM initialization/state, training schedule, early stopping, donor folds, common head, five seeds, and local artifact hashes.
Validate exact same-nucleus joins for GSE296875. Reject GSE244832 different-aliquot rows as multimodal pairs.
Keep p_atac_scale, p_atac_mean, joint latent, and MultiPosterior.imputation out of the RNA-conditioned ATAC task because each consumes observed ATAC.
Do not download or load hosted trainer pickle files. Use project-fitted state dicts with exact key/shape/dtype manifests and controlled local loading.
Validate Python 3.7-era dependencies, Torch/CUDA compatibility, L40S import/forward/backward, deterministic seeds, BatchNorm behavior, resume, and memory on an approved smoke job.
Prove GSE289173 receives anonymized RNA only after selection lock and cannot influence feature selection, adaptation, GMM state, head fitting, or calibration before prediction hashes are committed.
